tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind everything; the ground for list rows and cards. Text on it: fg, muted (both 4.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar background. Text on it: fg, muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, dialogs, popovers, the detail panel. Text on it: fg, muted, and the *-text colors.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control track, kbd, notes: one step off surface. Text: fg, muted.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, side, surface and field.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, placeholders, meta (mono) text on bg, side, surface, field (5.0:1 on bg, the tightest ground). Not for disabled state.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet row borders. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control (1.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, dialog and button edges where a text label already identifies the control. Not enough alone for a field or toggle: use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edge of fields, toggles, checkboxes and any control with no text label: 3:1 or more on surface, field and bg in both schemes. NEW: replaces border on those.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on quiet buttons, nav items, icon buttons. Replaces the 5/6/8/10% fg mixes.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed wash and the backdrop of a selected icon button.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item and selected list row tint (accent at 12%). Text on it stays fg.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs, with blur(6px).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress ring (was --ring-track).

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb. Hover: scrollbar-hover.

tokens.name: scrollbar-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb on hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal-cyan: selection, today, focus, links, the Stand ring, the secondary action fill. Fills and rings only (3.5:1 on surface). Text uses accent-text. Was --stand.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and icons on bg, side, surface, field: links, 'today' label, dates. 4.5:1 or more in both schemes. NEW (accent as text was 3.5:1, 2.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (4.6:1 and 12.9:1). Was white in light, which gave 3.8:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. Reads 3:1 or more on bg, side, surface and field. NEW (accent was 2.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Crimson: the brand color, the Move ring, the main action, overdue, blocked, errors, destructive. Fill only. Was --move.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger-colored text on bg, side, surface, field: overdue date, error message, 'blocks' label. 4.5:1 or more. NEW.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (4.8:1 light, 4.8:1 dark). Was white in both, 4.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Green: done, the Exercise ring, the Toggle on-state, the success CTA. Fill only. Was --exercise (and --goal, removed).

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success-colored text on bg, side, surface, field. NEW (was 3.4:1).

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill (4.8:1 light). The white check mark on a done checkbox uses on-success too. Was white (3.6:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Amber: due soon, a reminder to ping, 'blocks N' on a task. Fill, border and icon only. Was --amber.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning-colored text on bg, side, surface, field. NEW (was 3.3:1).

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill (5.0:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Blue: priority 2, quadrant 2, informational chips. Was --blue, which a palette swatch also claimed.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Orange: priority 4 and quadrant 3. Was --orange, silently overridden by the palette's orange.

tokens.name: meeting
tokens.usage: Violet: meetings (mark, striped calendar events), quadrant 4. 5.4:1 on surface in light. Was --violet.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Graphite: cancelled, archived, no-state fills. Was --graphite.

tokens.name: priority-1
tokens.usage: Priority 1, Minimal: double chevron down. 3:1 on surface and bg. Light value darkened from #5A9BE6 (2.7:1).

tokens.name: priority-2
tokens.usage: Priority 2, Low: chevron down.

tokens.name: priority-3
tokens.usage: Priority 3, Medium: equals sign. Light value was #D99100 (2.5:1); now #AB7300, 3:1 on surface and bg. Dark is the warning amber.

tokens.name: priority-4
tokens.usage: Priority 4, High: chevron up. Light value was #F2600C, now caution.

tokens.name: priority-5
tokens.usage: Priority 5, Maximum: double chevron up. Light value was #E0102F, a near-duplicate of danger.

tokens.name: quadrant-1
tokens.usage: Matrix quadrant 1, do now.

tokens.name: quadrant-2
tokens.usage: Matrix quadrant 2, plan.

tokens.name: quadrant-3
tokens.usage: Matrix quadrant 3, delegate.

tokens.name: quadrant-4
tokens.usage: Matrix quadrant 4, drop.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Count badge inside a filter button. The only 10px text; nothing smaller.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under fields, tag chip text (600), tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section and group labels. Set UPPERCASE with letter-spacing 0.08em, in muted.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Chips, buttons in dense bars, search input, fine print. The most used size.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: row titles (500), notes, fields.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Nav items, field values that must stand out.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Detail-panel title, quick-entry title. Was 16 and 17.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Space heading in the list header, letter-spacing -0.01em. Was weight 800.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, created time, due flags. Tabular numbers.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Home widgets and floating cards. Was --card-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, the close X. One value replaces the -18px and -24px variants.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: The card in the user's hand while dragging.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a segmented control, toggle thumb lift.

spacing.note: 4px rhythm with a 2px hairline step. Source gaps of 1, 3, 5, 7, 10px snap to these.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gap: icon to badge, stacked nav items, segmented-control padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, tag chips, icon and label inside a small control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in chip rows and toolbars; vertical gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between inline controls; row padding (vertical), button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row padding (horizontal), gap between detail-panel fields, dialog stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, widget padding, section gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Window gutter (main column) and the gap between widgets. Was 22px.

radius.note: Six steps and a full round. 3 to 5px snap to xs, 6 and 7 to sm, 9 and 10 to md, 11 and 12 to lg, 14 to 18 to xl.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb, inline marks, tiny close buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox, kbd, due flag, nav icon well, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, nav items, chips, segmented-control segments, buttons in dense bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, task rows, kanban cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Kanban columns, home widgets, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, settings window, quick-entry card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills (tags, count badges), toggle, ring wells.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside meta text and chips (due, waiting, link).

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Default Lucide icon in controls and nav.

tokens.name: size-checkbox
tokens.usage: Task checkbox, row and card alike. Was 17px, with a 15px native pickbox.

tokens.name: size-ctl-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented control, tiny toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: size-ctl-md
tokens.usage: Header controls: search, icon buttons, sort, theme switch. Was 26, 28, 30 and 32.

tokens.name: size-ctl-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons in dialogs and the detail panel; text inputs in forms.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left sidebar width (resizable in the app).

tokens.name: size-detail
tokens.usage: Right detail panel width (resizable in the app).

zIndex.note: Five layers. The source had 14 values, with the tooltip and the drag ghost both at 50.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Close X, selection checkbox over a card.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky bars on the home screen and in lists.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim and dialog layer.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, calendar, menus: above dialogs.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Hover tooltips with key hints.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: Drag ghost: above everything but never under a tooltip's pointer.

timing.note: Three durations and one curve. Source used 5 durations.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, opacity, press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Position, size and color changes in controls.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Card lift, drop animation, indicator slide.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The only curve: fast start, soft landing.
